PcosCycleFertility.6: Ku-PCOS, umjikelezo wakho ungaba mude, ungalingani, futhi kwesinye isikhathi kube nzima ukuwubikezela. Ukuqonda okwenzekayo eduze nokukhipha iqanda kungakusiza uqonde umjikelezo wakho kangcono nemibuzo ehlobene nokuzala.
PcosCycleFertility.14: Uma kufanele ubone udokotela uma ufuna ukukhulelwa
PcosCycleFertility.16: Umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini kuncike ekulandelaneni okuhlelekile kwezimpawu zama-hormone. Ku-PCOS, lokhu kuhleleka kungaphazamiseka, ikakhulukazi ekukhuleni kwama-follicle nasekukhipheni iqanda.
PcosCycleFertility.17: Amaqanda esibeletho angaba nama-follicle amaningi amancane aqala ukukhula ngaphandle kokuthi i-follicle eyinhloko ifinyelele ekuvuthweni njalo. Ukukhipha iqanda kungase kubambezeleke, kwenzeke ngokungalindelekile, noma kungenzeki nhlobo emijikelezweni ethile.
PcosCycleFertility.18: Lesi esinye sezizathu ezenza abanye abantu abanayo i-PCOS babe nemijikelezo yezinsuku ezingu-35, 45, noma ngezinye izikhathi ngaphezulu, kuyilapho abanye bengaba nemijikelezo eseduze nobude obujwayelekile.
PcosCycleFertility.20: Ubude bomjikelezo bodwa abukutsheli ukuthi ukukhipha iqanda kwenzekile yini. Imijikelezo emibili yobude obufanayo ingaba nendaba ehlukile yama-hormone.
PcosCycleFertility.21: Ukukhipha iqanda ukukhululwa kweqanda esibelethweni. Kulandela isigaba sokuvuthwa kwama-follicle futhi kwandulela isigaba se-luteal somjikelezo.
PcosCycleFertility.22: Emjikelezweni olinganayo, ukukhipha iqanda kuvame ukuba maphakathi. Kodwa ku-PCOS, lo mthetho olula awusebenzi njalo. Ukukhipha iqanda kungaba sekwedlule isikhathi kakhulu noma kungenzeki nhlobo emjikelezweni othile.
PcosCycleFertility.24: Uma ukukhipha iqanda kungabikezelekile, kuba nzima kakhulu ukulinganisa isikhathi sokuzala usebenzisa izinsuku zokuya esikhathini kuphela.
PcosCycleFertility.25: Kukhona izimpawu eziningana zomzimba ezingahambisana nezinguquko zama-hormone eduze nokukhipha iqanda. Zingaba usizo ekubukeni umjikelezo wakho siqu, kodwa akukho uphawu olulodwa olungaqinisekisa ukukhipha iqanda ngokuphelele.
PcosCycleFertility.26: Ushintsho emanzini omlomo wesibeletho, angaba maningi, acacile, futhi aluleke
PcosCycleFertility.27: Ubuhlungu obuncane noma ukungakhululeki enhlonzeni kwabanye besifazane
PcosCycleFertility.28: Ushintsho ekushiseni komzimba ngemva kokukhipha iqanda
PcosCycleFertility.30: Ukwenyuka okungenzeka kwesifiso socansi kwabanye besifazane
PcosCycleFertility.31: Amanzi omlomo wesibeletho aphawulekayo ikakhulukazi ukuwabuka. Njengoba isikhathi sokuzala sisondela, angaba maningi, acacile, acwebile, futhi aluleke. Kodwa-ke, ukubonakala kwawo kungahluka komunye nomunye nakumjikelezo nomjikelezo.
PcosCycleFertility.33: Ngemijikelezo engalingani kakhulu, usuku lokukhipha iqanda olubalwa ngokuzenzakalela emijikelezweni edlule lungaba ngolulinganiselwe kakhulu. Isibikezelo asiyona isiqinisekiso sezokwelapha sokukhipha iqanda.
PcosCycleFertility.34: I-PCOS ingenza ukukhulelwa kube nzima, ikakhulukazi uma ukukhipha iqanda kungavamile noma kunzima ukukubikezela. Kodwa-ke, ukuba ne-PCOS akusho ukungazali.
PcosCycleFertility.35: Abanye besifazane abanayo i-PCOS bakhipha iqanda njalo futhi bakhulelwe ngaphandle kobunzima obuthile. Kwabanye, ukukhipha iqanda akulingani kangangokuthi kudinga ukuhlolwa nokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okungenzeka.
PcosCycleFertility.37: Ubunzima obuyinhloko ngokuvamile ukukhipha iqanda okungalingani noma okungabikezelekile
PcosCycleFertility.38: Ukukhipha iqanda kungenzeka ngisho nalapho imijikelezo mide kakhulu
PcosCycleFertility.40: Uhambo lokuzala luncike kumuntu ngamunye nezinye izinto eziningi
PcosCycleFertility.41: Ukuzala akuncikile ekukhipheni iqanda kuphela. Iminyaka, ikhwalithi yesidoda sozakwenu, isimo sezindlala zeqanda, i-endometrium, nezinye izinto nazo zingadlala indima. Yingakho ukuhlolwa okuphelele kubalulekile uma ukukhulelwa kuthatha isikhathi eside kunokulindelekile.
PcosCycleFertility.42: Ama-app okulandelela isikhathi ngokuvamile asebenzisa idatha yemijikelezo edlule ukuze akhiqize ukulinganisa. Uma imijikelezo ilingana kakhulu, lokhu kulinganisa kungaba usizo njengenkomba.
PcosCycleFertility.43: Kodwa-ke, ku-PCOS, ukuhluka komjikelezo kungenza lokhu kubala kungathembeki kangako. I-app ayikwazi ukwazi ngokuqinisekile ukuthi ukukhipha iqanda kwenzekile ngoba usuku lwethiyori selufikile.
PcosCycleFertility.45: Ukulandelela ngedijithali kuwusizo kakhulu ekubukeni izindlela zomjikelezo wakho siqu nasekugcineni umlando ongawabelana nomhlinzeki wakho wezempilo.
PcosCycleFertility.46: Ukulandelela njalo kungakusiza uqonde kangcono ukuhluka kwakho siqu. Inhloso akulona ukwenza umjikelezo ubikezelwe ngokuphelele, kodwa ukuqoqa ulwazi olwanele lokubona izindlela.
PcosCycleFertility.47: Qaphela usuku losuku lokuqala lomjikelezo ngamunye, ngisho nalapho imijikelezo ihlukene kakhulu
PcosCycleFertility.48: Qaphela izinguquko emanzini omlomo wesibeletho emjikelezweni wonke
PcosCycleFertility.49: Qaphela noma yibuphi ubuhlungu benhlonzi noma ezinye izimpawu ezingahambisana nokukhipha iqanda
PcosCycleFertility.50: Gwema ukuncika kuphela ebudeni obujwayelekile bezinsuku ezingu-28 ukuze ubikezele ukukhipha iqanda
PcosCycleFertility.51: Sebenzisa izivivinyo zokukhipha iqanda ngokuqaphela futhi, uma kudingeka, cela iseluleko sochwepheshe
PcosCycleFertility.52: Yabelana nolwazi oluqoqayo nochwepheshe wezempilo uma ufuna ukukhulelwa
PcosCycleFertility.53: Kungaba usizo futhi ukuqaphela izimpawu ezihambisanayo: ubuhlungu, izinyosi, izinguquko emanzini, ukopha okungajwayelekile, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, noma ezinye izinto ozibonayo. Lolu lwazi lungasiza ukwakha isithombe esigcwele somjikelezo wakho.
PcosCycleFertility.54: Ukubonana kungaba nenzuzo ngisho nangaphambi kokuqala ukuzama ukukhulelwa, uma imijikelezo ingalingani kakhulu, ihlukene kakhulu, noma uma ukuya esikhathini kungabikho isikhathi eside.
PcosCycleFertility.55: Uchwepheshe wezempilo angaphenya izimbangela zokungalingani, ahlole ukukhipha iqanda, futhi uma kudingeka, aphakamise uhlelo olufanele amacebo akho okukhulelwa.
PcosCycleFertility.57: Uma ukuya kwakho esikhathini kuhlukene kakhulu, uma ungakaze uye esikhathini izinyanga eziningana, noma uma ukukhulelwa kungenzeki naphezu kokuya ocansini njalo, khuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo.
PcosCycleFertility.59: I-PCOS ingenza imijikelezo ibe mide futhi ingabikezelekile.
PcosCycleFertility.60: Ukukhipha iqanda kungase kungalingani noma kungabikho emijikelezweni ethile.
PcosCycleFertility.61: Umjikelezo ongalingani awusho ngokuzenzakalela ukuntuleka kokuzala.
PcosCycleFertility.62: Izibikezelo ezisekelwe kukhalenda kuphela zingase zingathembeki kakhulu ku-PCOS.
PcosCycleFertility.63: Ukubuka umjikelezo wakho nokugcina umlando kungaba usizo, ikakhulukazi ekubonaneni nodokotela.
PcosCycleFertility.65: I-PCOS ayibonakali ngendlela efanayo kuwo wonke amantombazane nabesifazane. Umjikelezo wakho ungashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukulandelela kukhona ukuze kukusize uqonde kangcono ukuthi umzimba wakho usebenza kanjani, hhayi ukuthatha isikhundla seseluleko sezokwelapha.
PcosCycleFertility.66: Lesi sihloko sisezinhloso zolwazi nezemfundo kuphela. Asiyona imbono yezokwelapha futhi asithathi isikhundla sokubonana nochwepheshe wezempilo.
PcosCycleFertility.67: Umjikelezo, ukukhipha iqanda, nokuzala ku-PCOS — AWA

PcosDiagnosis.6: Indlela i-PCOS ehlolwa ngayo, ukuthi yiziphi izivivinyo ezingase zinikezwe, nokuthi ungazilungiselela kanjani ngokuthula ukubonana kwakho.
PcosDiagnosis.15: Ukuhlolwa kwe-polycystic ovary syndrome akuncikile esivivinyweni esisodwa. Uchwepheshe wezempilo ubuthanisa ulwazi oluningana: umlando wemijikelezo yakho, noma yiziphi izimpawu, ukuhlolwa komzimba, izivivinyo zaselabhorethri, futhi, kuye ngesimo, i-ultrasound.
PcosDiagnosis.16: Inhloso kokubili ukubheka izimpawu ezihambisana ne-PCOS nokukhipha ezinye izimbangela ezingachaza ukuya esikhathini okungalingani noma ezinye izimpawu zama-hormone.
PcosDiagnosis.18: Ukuhlolwa kuhlala kwenzelwe umuntu ngamunye. Abesifazane ababili abanayo i-PCOS bangaba nezimpawu nemiphumela yezivivinyo ehluke kakhulu.
PcosDiagnosis.19: Ukuphenywa kungalandela izinyathelo eziningana. Azenziwa ngendlela efanayo ngempela kubo bonke.
PcosDiagnosis.21: Uchwepheshe uqoqa umlando wakho: imijikelezo, izimpawu, umlando wezokwelapha, nokwelashwa.
PcosDiagnosis.23: Ubheka ikakhulukazi izimpawu zokweqile kwama-androgen futhi uhlola isimo sakho jikelele.
PcosDiagnosis.25: Izivivinyo zama-hormone nezemetabolism zingase zicelwe ukucacisa isimo.
PcosDiagnosis.27: Ingagcwalisa ukuphenywa ngokubuka ukubonakala kwamaqanda esibeletho.
PcosDiagnosis.33: Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kungase kunikezwe ukubheka izimpawu zokweqile kwama-androgen, ukuhlola ama-hormone athile ayingxenye yomsebenzi wokuzala, nokubheka ezinye izimbangela ezingenzeka zezimpawu zakho.
PcosDiagnosis.34: Izivivinyo ezikhethiwe zincike eminyakeni yakho, ezimpawini zakho, emlandweni wakho wezokwelapha, nakulokho uchwepheshe afuna ukukuhlola.
PcosDiagnosis.38: Usiza ikakhulukazi ekukhipheni ezinye izimbangela zemijikelezo engalingani.
PcosDiagnosis.40: Ushukela egazini, kwesinye isikhathi ipaneli yamafutha ngokuya ngezinto eziyingozi.
PcosDiagnosis.42: Imiphumela yama-hormone idinga ukuhunyushwa kanye nomongo wezokwelapha. Inani elilodwa ngokuvamile alanele, ngokwalo, ukuphetha ngokuhlolwa kwe-PCOS.
PcosDiagnosis.43: I-ultrasound ingasetshenziselwa ukubuka ukubonakala kwamaqanda esibeletho futhi ibheke ikakhulukazi inani eliphezulu lama-follicle amancane. Futhi ivumela uchwepheshe ukuthi abheke ezinye izinto ezingachaza izimpawu ezithile.
PcosDiagnosis.45: Ukubona ama-follicle amaningi ku-ultrasound akusho ngokuzenzakalela ukuthi unayo i-PCOS. Umphumela udinga ukuhunyushwa kanye nokunye kokuphenywa.
PcosDiagnosis.46: Ukutholakala ne-PCOS akwenzi kube nokwenzeka ukubikezela ngqo ukuthi izinto zizokuhamba kanjani kuwe. Lesi sifo singabonakala ngendlela ehluke kakhulu komunye nomunye.
PcosDiagnosis.51: Ulwazi oluncane olulungiselelwe kusengaphambili lungasiza uchwepheshe aqonde umlando wakho futhi akhethe izivivinyo ezifaneleke kakhulu.
PcosDiagnosis.52: Imijikelezo yakho ibilokhu ingalingani isikhathi esingakanani?
PcosDiagnosis.53: Ingabe uqaphele izinyosi, ukukhula kwezinwele okungajwayelekile, noma ukuthuthuka kwezinwele?
PcosDiagnosis.54: Ingabe kukhona umlando womndeni we-PCOS noma isifo sikashukela?
PcosDiagnosis.55: Ingabe ufisa ukukhulelwa esikhathini esifushane noma esiphakathi?
PcosDiagnosis.57: Uma kungenzeka, qaphela izinsuku zesikhathi sakho sokugcina, ubude obulinganiselwe bemijikelezo yakho, izimpawu ozibonayo, nanoma yikuphi ukwelashwa noma izithasiselo ozisebenzisayo.
PcosDiagnosis.59: Ukuhlolwa kuncike ezintweni eziningana, hhayi isivivinyo esisodwa.
PcosDiagnosis.60: Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kungabheka ukungalingani okuthile kwama-hormone futhi kukhiphe ezinye izimbangela.
PcosDiagnosis.62: Imiphumela kufanele ihlale ihunyushwa uchwepheshe wezempilo.
PcosDiagnosis.64: Ukuphenywa kwe-PCOS akusona isivivinyo esisodwa noma isinqumo sokugcina. Kukusiza uqonde ukusebenza kwama-hormone akho, ubheke ezinye izimbangela ezingenzeka, futhi wakhe ukunakekelwa okufanele isimo sakho.
PcosDiagnosis.65: Lesi sihloko sesolwazi kuphela futhi asithathi isikhundla sokubonana nodokotela noma sokuhunyushwa kwemiphumela yezivivinyo zakho okwenzelwe wena.

PcosHormonalAcne.6: Kungani izinyosi zama-hormone zingavela ne-PCOS, indlela yokuzibona, nokuthi yiziphi izixazululo ezingasiza ukuzilawula.
PcosHormonalAcne.7: Zithinta abesifazane abaningi futhi azibangelwa ukuntuleka kwenhlanzeko noma azigwemeki: ukuqonda isiqalo sazo kusiza ukuzilawula kangcono.
PcosHormonalAcne.17: Izinyosi zama-hormone uhlobo lwezinyosi oluhlobene ngokuqondile nokushintshashintsha kwama-hormone noma ukungalingani, ikakhulukazi kuma-androgen. Ngokungafani nezinyosi ezijwayelekile zobusha, zivame ukuthinta abesifazane abadala futhi zingaqhubeka noma zivele ngemva kwalesi sikhathi.
PcosHormonalAcne.18: Zihlukaniswa futhi ngendawo, ukujula, nokuthambekela kokuphinda zivele ezindaweni ezifanayo naphezu kwenqubo yokunakekela isikhumba elandelwa kahle.
PcosHormonalAcne.20: Izinyosi zama-hormone azihlobene nokuntuleka kwenhlanzeko: ukugeza ubuso kaningi akuzenzi zinyamalale, futhi kungase futhi kucasule isikhumba.
PcosHormonalAcne.22: Ku-PCOS, ukweqile okuhlobene kwama-androgen kushukumisa izindlala zamafutha, ezibe sezikhiqiza amafutha amaningi. Esinye isikhumba siphinde sizwele kakhulu kulawa ma-hormone, okuchaza ukuthi kungani izinyosi zingaba zinkulu ngisho nangaphandle kokungalingani okukhulu okulinganiswe elabhorethri.
PcosHormonalAcne.23: Lokhu akulona udaba lwamandla okuzikhandla: lokhu kuzwela kuhluka komunye nomunye futhi akuncikile ezinhlotsheni zakho zokuphila.
PcosHormonalAcne.25: Izimpawu ezithile zivame ukubuya, nakuba zingabuyi njalo:
PcosHormonalAcne.27: Izinyosi ezijule kakhulu, ngezinye izikhathi ezibuhlungu
PcosHormonalAcne.31: Izinyosi zama-hormone zingashintshashintsha emjikelezweni wonke. Abesifazane abaningi baqaphela ukwanda ezinsukwini ezandulela isikhathi sabo, lapho i-progesterone ikhuphuka bese ihla kakhulu, ishukumisa okwesikhashana ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha.
PcosHormonalAcne.33: Ukuqaphela ukuthi izinyosi zivela nini maqondana nomjikelezo wakho kungakusiza wena nodokotela wesikhumba nibone kangcono ukuxhumana kwama-hormone.
PcosHormonalAcne.35: Imikhuba embalwa elula yokunakekela ingasiza ukunciphisa ukwanda, ngaphandle kokuzisusa ngokuphelele yodwa:
PcosHormonalAcne.36: Geza isikhumba sakho ngobumnene ekuseni nakusihlwa
PcosHormonalAcne.38: Vikela isikhumba sakho elangeni nsuku zonke
PcosHormonalAcne.40: Ngokuya ngesimo, udokotela wesikhumba noma ongoti wesifazane angaphakamisa ukwelashwa okwenziwa esikhumbeni (amakhilimu, ama-gel) noma, uma kudingeka, ukwelashwa kwama-hormone okufanele.
PcosHormonalAcne.42: Ukwelashwa kwezinyosi zama-hormone (ngokwesikhumba noma ngama-hormone) kufanele kunikezwe futhi kubhekwe uchwepheshe wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma unethemba lokukhulelwa.
PcosHormonalAcne.44: Iseluleko sezokwelapha siwusizo ikakhulukazi ezimeni ezithile:
PcosHormonalAcne.51: Izinyosi zama-hormone zinesizathu esikhonjiwe, esihlobene nama-androgen.
PcosHormonalAcne.52: Zivame ukuthinta ingxenye engezansi yobuso futhi zingaba zimbi ngaphambi kwesikhathi sakho.
PcosHormonalAcne.54: Ukunakekelwa okuthambile futhi, uma kudingeka, ukwelashwa okufanele kungazithuthukisa.
PcosHormonalAcne.55: Udokotela wesikhumba noma ongoti wesifazane angakusekela uma ziqhubeka.
PcosHormonalAcne.57: Lesi sihloko sesolwazi jikelele kuphela futhi asithathi isikhundla sokubonana nodokotela. Uma unokungabaza noma uma izimpawu ziqhubeka, cela iseluleko kochwepheshe wezempilo.

PcosIntro.6: I-polycystic ovary syndrome, evame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-PCOS, isimo sama-hormone esivamile esingathinta imijikelezo yakho, ukukhipha iqanda, isikhumba, izinwele, imetabolism, futhi ngezinye izikhathi nokuzala.
PcosIntro.7: Indlela ebonakala ngayo ihluka kakhulu komunye wesifazane nakomunye. Ukuqonda i-PCOS kukusiza ikakhulukazi ukuthi ubone izimpawu zayo, wazi ukuthi nini ufuna iseluleko sezokwelapha, futhi ulandelele indlela eguquka ngayo ngaphandle kokuzisola.
PcosIntro.22: I-polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) isimo sama-hormone esivamile esingashintsha ukusebenza okujwayelekile kwamaqanda esibeletho nokulingana kwama-hormone athile.
PcosIntro.23: Kwabanye besifazane, inkinga eyinhloko ukukhipha iqanda okungalingani. Kwabanye, yizinyosi, ukukhula kwezinwele ngokweqile, ukuthuthuka kwezinwele, noma izimpawu zemetabolism ezivela kuqala.
PcosIntro.25: Naphezu negama layo, i-PCOS ayisho ngempela ukuthi amaqanda esibeletho aqukethe “ama-cyst”. Igama lomlando lingadukisa, futhi i-ultrasound yodwa ayanele ukwenza ukuhlolwa.
PcosIntro.27: Akukho sizathu esisodwa se-PCOS. Kubonakala kuvela ezintweni eziningana ezingahlangana: ukuthambekela komndeni, ukusebenza kwama-hormone, ukukhipha iqanda, imetabolism, nezinto zomuntu ngamunye.
PcosIntro.33: I-PCOS akulona iphutha lomuntu. Ayiveli nje ngokuntuleka kwamandla okuzikhandla, ukudla okubi, noma ukuntuleka kokuzivocavoca.
PcosIntro.35: I-PCOS ingabonakala ngendlela ehluke kakhulu komunye wesifazane nakomunye. Abanye banezimpawu eziningana, kuyilapho abanye beziqaphela kancane kakhulu.
PcosIntro.36: Imijikelezo engalingani, ehlukene kakhulu, noma ngezinye izikhathi engekho
PcosIntro.37: Ukukhipha iqanda okungalingani noma okunzima ukukubikezela
PcosIntro.38: Izinyosi eziqhubekayo, ikakhulukazi engxenyeni engezansi yobuso
PcosIntro.39: Ukukhula kwezinwele okwandile ebusweni, esifubeni, noma emzimbeni
PcosIntro.41: Ukwenyuka kwesisindo noma ubunzima bokunciphisa isisindo
PcosIntro.44: Ukuba nesinye salezi zimpawu akusho ngokuzenzakalela ukuthi unayo i-PCOS. Ezinye izimo eziningana zingabangela izimpawu ezifanayo.
PcosIntro.46: Ukuhlola i-PCOS inqubo yezokwelapha. Umhlinzeki wezempilo ngokuvamile uqala ngokuxoxa ngemijikelezo yakho, izimpawu, umlando wezokwelapha, nanoma yikuphi ukwelashwa ukusebenzisayo.
PcosIntro.47: Ngokuya ngesimo, izivivinyo zegazi zama-hormone ne-ultrasound nazo zingase zinikezwe.
PcosIntro.48: Imijikelezo engalingani noma ukukhipha iqanda okungavamile
PcosIntro.49: Izimpawu zokweqile kwama-androgen: izinyosi, ukukhula kwezinwele ngokweqile, ukuthuthuka kwezinwele, noma imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwegazi
PcosIntro.50: Ukubonakala kwamaqanda esibeletho okuhambisana ne-PCOS ku-ultrasound, uma lokhu kuhlolwa kukhonjisiwe
PcosIntro.51: Udokotela kufanele futhi akhiphe ezinye izimbangela ezingenzeka zemijikelezo engalingani noma ukweqile kwama-androgen ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwe-PCOS.
PcosIntro.53: Ukukhipha iqanda ukukhululwa kweqanda (i-oocyte) esibelethweni. Ku-PCOS, ukukhipha iqanda kungavama kancane noma kube nzima ukukubikezela.
PcosIntro.54: Lokhu kungachaza ukuthi kungani imijikelezo ngezinye izikhathi imide, ingalingani, noma inzima ukuyilindela.
PcosIntro.56: Ukurekhoda izinsuku zesikhathi sakho, izimpawu, nanoma yiziphi izimpawu zokukhipha iqanda kungakusiza uqonde kangcono izindlela zakho siqu.
PcosIntro.58: Ngenxa yokuthi ukukhipha iqanda kungase kungalingani, abanye besifazane abanayo i-PCOS bangaba nobunzima obukhulu bokukhulelwa.
PcosIntro.59: Lokhu akusho, kodwa-ke, ukuthi i-PCOS ivimbela ngokuzenzakalela ukukhulelwa. Abesifazane abaningi abanayo i-PCOS bakhulelwa ngokwemvelo noma ngosizo lwezokwelapha olufanele.
PcosIntro.61: Ubunzima bokukhulelwa abusho ukuthi akunakwenzeka. Uma unethemba lokukhulelwa, udokotela noma umbelethisi angaphakamisa uhlelo olufanele isimo sakho.
PcosIntro.63: I-PCOS ingahlotshaniswa nezinguquko zemetabolism, kuhlanganise nokumelana ne-insulin kwabanye besifazane.
PcosIntro.64: Kodwa-ke, isisindo sodwa asikwazi ukuhlola noma ukukhipha i-PCOS. Owesifazane obhokile angaba nayo i-PCOS, njengoba nje owesifazane onesisindo esiningi engase angabi nayo.
PcosIntro.65: Ukunakekelwa okulandelayo kufanele kucabangele impilo iyonke, hhayi inani elisesilinganisweni kuphela.
PcosIntro.67: Ukweqile okuhlobene kwama-androgen kungathinta izindlala zamafutha nezimpande zezinwele.
PcosIntro.68: Ngokuya ngowesifazane, lokhu kungabonakala njengezinyosi eziqhubekayo, ukukhula kwezinwele okwandile, noma ukuthuthuka kwezinwele.
PcosIntro.73: Akukho ndlela eyodwa yokuphatha i-PCOS esebenzela wonke owesifazane. Ukukhetha kuncike ezimpawini, ezinhlosweni, nasezimweni zezokwelapha.
PcosIntro.74: Inhloso ingahluka ngokuya ngesigaba sokuphila: ukulungisa imijikelezo, ukuthuthukisa izimpawu ezithile, ukuvikela impilo yemetabolism, noma ukusekela uhlelo lokukhulelwa.
PcosIntro.76: Ukudla ukudla okuhlukahlukene, okujwayelekile okufanele izidingo zakho
PcosIntro.79: Ukulandelela indlela imijikelezo yakho nezimpawu eziguquka ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
PcosIntro.81: Ngokuya ngezidingo zakho, umhlinzeki wezempilo angase futhi anikeze ukwelashwa kwezimpawu ezithile noma ukusekela uhlelo lokukhulelwa.
PcosIntro.83: Ukwelashwa kwama-hormone, imithi yemetabolism, nezithasiselo zokudla kufanele konke kuxoxwe nomhlinzeki wezempilo.
PcosIntro.85: I-PCOS ihlale isho ukuba “nama-cyst”: igama lingadukisa. Ukuhlolwa akuncikile kuphela ekubeni khona kwama-cyst.
PcosIntro.86: Bonke abesifazane abanayo i-PCOS banesisindo esiningi: i-PCOS ingathinta abesifazane bazo zonke izinhlobo zemizimba.
PcosIntro.87: I-PCOS ihlale ivimbela ukukhulelwa: ukukhipha iqanda kungase kungalingani, kodwa ukukhulelwa kusenokwenzeka.
PcosIntro.88: Uphawu olulodwa luyanela ukuhlola i-PCOS: ukuhlolwa kudinga ukuhlolwa okuphelele.
PcosIntro.89: I-PCOS iyanyamalala nje ngeminyaka: indlela ebonakala ngayo ingashintsha impilo yonke, kodwa ukulandelela okuqhubekayo kusabalulekile.
PcosIntro.91: Iseluleko sezokwelapha siwusizo ikakhulukazi lapho imijikelezo iba nga lingani kakhulu, imiswa izinyanga eziningana, noma lapho kuvela izimpawu ezingajwayelekile.
PcosIntro.101: Akubona bonke abesifazane abanayo i-PCOS abanezimpawu ezifanayo.
PcosIntro.102: Isisindo sodwa asinele ukuhlola noma ukukhipha i-PCOS.
PcosIntro.104: I-PCOS ingathinta ukukhipha iqanda futhi ngezinye izikhathi nokuzala.
PcosIntro.105: Indlela yokunakekela eyenzelwe umuntu ngamunye isiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zowesifazane ngamunye.
PcosIntro.107: Lesi sihloko senzelwe ulwazi jikelele futhi asithathi isikhundla sokubonana nodokotela. Isimo ngasinye sihlukile: uma unokungabaza noma uma izimpawu ziqhubeka, cela iseluleko kochwepheshe wezempilo.

PcosLifestyleManagement.6: Izinketho zokuphatha i-PCOS, nemikhuba elula yokusekela impilo yakho yansuku zonke.
PcosLifestyleManagement.16: Hlukanisa ukudla ukuze ugweme indlala enkulu
PcosLifestyleManagement.17: Nciphisa ushukela osheshayo nokudla okuphathwe kakhulu ezimbonini
PcosLifestyleManagement.18: Akukho kudla okungavunyelwe: hlosha ukulingana jikelele kunemithetho eqinile
PcosLifestyleManagement.19: Akukho ukwelashwa okukodwa kwe-PCOS: ukuphatha kwenzelwe izimpawu zakho, izinto ezibalulekile kuwe (umjikelezo, ukuzala, isikhumba, isisindo), nesimo sakho siqu. Kungahlanganisa izinyathelo zendlela yokuphila, ukwelashwa kwama-hormone, noma ezinye izinketho ngokuya ngezidingo zakho.
PcosLifestyleManagement.20: Ukuzivocavoca njalo, ngisho nokulinganiselayo (ukuhamba ngokushesha, ukugibela ibhayisikili, ukuziqinisa kancane), kusiza ukusekela ukulingana kwama-hormone nemetabolism. Ukuqhubeka kubalulekile kakhulu kunamandla.
PcosLifestyleManagement.21: Ukulala ngokwanele nokuthatha izikhathi zokuphumula njalo kusiza ukunciphisa umthelela wengcindezi ekulinganeni kwama-hormone, okungathinta izimpawu ze-PCOS.
PcosLifestyleManagement.23: Izinguquko ezincane, ezihlala isikhathi eside zivame ukuba nempumelelo enkulu ekugcineni kunezinguquko ezinkulu ezinzima ukuzigcina.
PcosLifestyleManagement.24: Ukuphila ne-PCOS kungasindisa isimo sakho sengqondo, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yezimpawu ezibonakalayo noma ukukhathazeka ngokuzala. Lokhu kuzwa kuvumelekile: ukukhuluma nomuntu oseduze nawe noma nochwepheshe kuyingxenye egcwele yokunakekelwa okuphelele.
PcosLifestyleManagement.26: Ubuhlungu benhlonzi obukhulu noma obungajwayelekile, ukopha okukhulu kakhulu noma okude, ukukhathala okukhulu noma ukoma okungajwayelekile okuqhubekayo, noma usizi lwemizwa olungena ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
PcosLifestyleManagement.28: I-PCOS iphathwa ngosuku nosuku ngemikhuba elula nokulandelela kwezokwelapha njalo: ukulungisa ngakunye okuncane kubalulekile, ngesivinini sakho.

PcosMetabolism.6: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-PCOS, isisindo, nokumelana ne-insulin — ngaphandle kokwahlulela noma izindlela ezimfushane.
PcosMetabolism.14: I-PCOS ivame ukuhlotshaniswa nezinguquko zemetabolism, kuhlanganise nokumelana ne-insulin. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kuhlobana akuthinti kuphela abesifazane abanesisindo esiningi — amaphrofayili emetabolism ayahluka komunye nomunye.
PcosMetabolism.15: I-insulin i-hormone esiza amaseli ukusebenzisa ushukela egazini. Ngokumelana ne-insulin, amaseli aphendula kancane kule hormone, futhi umzimba ungase unxephezele ngokukhiqiza i-insulin eningi.
PcosMetabolism.16: Ku-PCOS, lokhu kungahlotshaniswa nokukhiqizwa okwandile kwama-androgen futhi kungase kunikele ezimpawini ezithile. Kodwa akubona bonke abesifazane abanayo i-PCOS abanephrofayili efanayo yemetabolism.
PcosMetabolism.18: Ukumelana ne-insulin kungahlolwa ngezivivinyo zegazi uma udokotela ekubheka kubalulekile. Ukuthi izivivinyo ziyadingeka yini kuncike esimweni sakho siqu.
PcosMetabolism.19: I-PCOS ithinta abesifazane bazo zonke izinhlobo zemizimba, kusuka kwabaphakeme kuya kwabaqinile.
PcosMetabolism.21: Ukunciphisa isisindo akuhlali kudingeka — noma akwanele ngokwakho — ukuthuthukisa izimpawu.
PcosMetabolism.22: Ukunciphisa isisindo okuncane kungasiza ngezinye izikhathi izinkomba ezithile zemetabolism noma ukulingana komjikelezo lapho kukhona isisindo esweqile.
PcosMetabolism.23: Inhloso akulona ukujaha isisindo “esiphelele”, kodwa ukwakha imikhuba ephilayo, ehlala isikhathi eside. Ukudla okulinganiselayo, ukunyakaza, nokulala okujwayelekile konke kungaba nesandla empilweni engcono yemetabolism.
PcosMetabolism.28: Ukulandelela kwezokwelapha kwe-PCOS akukhawulelwe emjikelezweni noma ezimpawini zama-hormone. Ngokuya ngephrofayili yakho, umhlinzeki wakho wezempilo angase futhi ayigade izinkomba ezithile zemetabolism ukusiza ukubona izinto eziyingozi ngokushesha.
PcosMetabolism.31: Udokotela wakho angase anqume ukuhlola izinkomba ezithile ngokuya ngezimpawu zakho, umlando wakho wezokwelapha, isimo somndeni wakho, nezinye izinto eziyingozi.
PcosMetabolism.33: Ushukela egazini kanye/noma i-HbA1c, ngokuya ngomongo
PcosMetabolism.36: Ukulandelela isisindo nobubanzi besinqe, ngaphandle kokwahlulela
PcosMetabolism.38: Izinguquko ezithile zifanele ukukhulunywa ngazo ngesikhathi sokubonana, ikakhulukazi uma zintsha, ziqhubeka, noma zingajwayelekile kuwe.
PcosMetabolism.40: Bika ukuya esikhathini okuhlukene kakhulu noma okungabikezelekile.
PcosMetabolism.42: Khuluma nodokotela wakho uma lezi zimpawu zivela ngendlela engajwayelekile.
PcosMetabolism.44: Ushintsho olusheshayo noma olungaqondakali lufanele ukuhlolwa.
PcosMetabolism.46: Bika noma yimuphi umlando womndeni wesifo sikashukela noma izimo zemetabolism.
PcosMetabolism.48: Ukoma okungajwayelekile, ukwenza umquba kaningi, ukukhathala okuqhubekayo, noma ushintsho olukhulu, olungaqondakali lwesisindo kufanele kubikwe kochwepheshe wezempilo. Lezi zimpawu zingaba nezimbangela eziningana futhi ngokwazo aziqinisekisi ukumelana ne-insulin noma isifo sikashukela.
PcosMetabolism.50: Udokotela wakho angase aphakamise ukuhlolwa njalo kunokuphenywa okukodwa. Inhloso ukulungisa iseluleko nezivivinyo ngendlela oqhubeka ngayo, ngaphandle kokugxila kusisindo kuphela.
PcosMetabolism.52: Isisindo siyingxenye eyodwa nje yesithombe semetabolism ku-PCOS. Indlela ephelele ibheka imijikelezo, izimpawu, imikhuba yokuphila, umlando wezokwelapha, nezinkomba zemetabolism.
